_note: Synthetic meetings for the Meetings workspace evals (MT-2). Names, places and numbers are invented. `model_lines` is what a mocked local model answers for the owner's bullets (some of it deliberately wrong: no citation, an invented name or number, a bullet that does not exist); `model_actions` is what a mocked model answers for action items (one invented, one that is a decision). `keep` lists the model_lines that must survive the faithfulness check, by position.

meetings.title: Launch planning
lines: Okay, thanks for joining. The launch date question first.
Marta says engineering can ship on the 14th if the payment review finishes by Monday.
Then we agree on the 14th. Devon, can you confirm the payment review with Priya?
I will ask Priya today and send you the answer by Friday.
Good. Budget next. We have forty thousand dollars for the Lisbon event.
Jonas wants to cut the Lisbon budget to thirty thousand.
No, we keep forty thousand. I will write that into the plan.
Fine. I will draft the Lisbon invitation list next week.

model_lines.text: The launch is set for the 14th, provided the payment review is done by Monday.
Devon will check the payment review with Priya and report back by Friday.
The Lisbon budget stays at forty thousand dollars; Jonas's proposal to cut it to thirty thousand was turned down.
The launch moves to the 21st after the Osaka review.
Devon is also leading the Berlin roadshow.

meetings.title: Vendor review
lines: Let's go through the two storage vendors.
Brightwater quoted twelve thousand a year with a two year term.
And Cobalt wants nine thousand but no support on weekends.
I will ask Cobalt whether weekend support can be added.
We decided to go with Brightwater if Cobalt says no.
Then I will email Brightwater a draft contract on Thursday.
Please also share the comparison sheet with Marta.
